tools.name: token_check
tools.description: Free. Coarse pre-trade rug check for one token: a Solana mint or link, or a Robinhood Chain pons 0x address or link. Returns verdict (avoid | caution | no_flags_observed), a reason and coverage; any other Solana mint gets a thin on-chain answer, never avoid on that evidence. Not a safety verdict. Ne

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Free. Start here: every tool with its price, arguments and x402 payment terms (USDC on Solana or Base), plus the label semantics URL. Use it first to choose a tool and budget; it carries no market data.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Free. Feed health: feed_lag_s (seconds behind the newest event), is_stale, last Solana slot, chain_lag_s and slots_behind (how far the tape is behind the chain, estimated from slots against the Solana RPC's processed tip). Use it before trusting a card's freshness.

tools.name: market_regime
tools.description: Free. pump.fun market regime: launches and curve buys and sells per minute, mayhem share, migrations vs true graduations, rug flags per hour. Use it to judge the market as a whole; for one mint use check_pumpfun_risk. No arguments.

tools.name: sample_mint
tools.description: Free. One full risk card (the exact paid mint_risk_card shape) for a mint aged >= 300 s with >= 3 buys, delayed. Use it to see every field before paying; the server picks the mint, so it is not a check on yours. No arguments.

tools.name: new_launches_free
tools.description: Free. New Solana tokens ranked: ten covered pump.fun mints under 30 s old by P(rug within 300 s) and ten under 15 min by P(true graduation), refreshed every 5 s, each with its paid check. Use it to find new memecoin launches worth a paid check. No arguments.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Free. Whether one to five pump.fun mints have full live coverage and a fresh feed (<= 5 s), with the exact prices. Use it right before a paid check; it returns no risk findings.

tools.name: watchlist_updates
tools.description: Free. Start or poll a watch cursor for one to five mints: whether new risk or lifecycle events exist, not what they are (a paid check returns them). Cursor lasts 24 h; poll every 15 s or slower. Use it to watch held mints without paying.

tools.name: check_pumpfun_risk
tools.description: $0.005 per call. Is this Solana token safe? Solana token safety check (rug check) for ONE pump.fun mint: calibrated rug probability and observed flags, not a safety guarantee. Use right before a swap or while holding it. Returns flags_observed | no_flags_observed (never a safety guarantee), findings

tools.name: check_watchlist_risk
tools.description: $0.01 per call for 1-5 mints, not per mint. Use when you hold or watch 2-5 pump.fun mints; for one mint check_pumpfun_risk ($0.005) costs less. Each gets the compact check item. Uncovered or stale: refused before payment. Not a safety guarantee. Fields: loopholetape://schema/check_watchlist_risk.

tools.name: verdict
tools.description: $0.01 per call. Is this Solana token a rug pull? Token safety verdict (rug check) for ONE pump.fun mint: avoid, caution or no_flags_observed (not a safety guarantee). Use when you need one bounded answer before you buy or hold it, with a free card page. Uncovered or stale: refused before payment. no

tools.name: mint_risk_card
tools.description: $0.025 per call. Solana token safety card for ONE token. Use when you need every field: holders, creator, flags, odds, market, authorities, cohorts with holder reputation. coverage thin = any other SPL mint (authorities, Token-2022). Fields: loopholetape://schema/mint_risk_card.

tools.name: pumpfun_recent_launches
tools.description: $0.01 per call. New Solana tokens: the newest pump.fun memecoin launches (default 1 h) as compact cards: curve SOL, buyers, concentration, flags. Use to screen new launches; poll with launches_since ($0.001). Stale feed: refused before payment. Fields: loopholetape://schema/pumpfun_recent_launches.

tools.name: recent_rugs
tools.description: $0.02 per call. Use to see which pump.fun tokens fired rug or close flags in a window and how (creator_sold, bundle_dumped, curve_drained, pool_drained), newest first. Not a check on one mint. Stale feed: refused before payment. Fields: loopholetape://schema/recent_rugs.

tools.name: recent_graduations
tools.description: $0.02 per call. Use to list recent pump.fun migrations to PumpSwap (default last 6 h): graduated=true means we saw the curve reach 84 SOL; each labelled instant_bundle or organic. Not a live rug check. Stale feed: refused before payment. Fields: loopholetape://schema/recent_graduations.

tools.name: creator_reputation
tools.description: $0.02 per call. Use to judge a new pump.fun token by its creator's earlier launches: graduations, rugs, median seconds to the dev's first sell, last 25 launches. Input: address (base58 wallet). Stale feed: refused before payment. Fields: loopholetape://schema/creator_reputation.

tools.name: wallet_profile
tools.description: $0.02 per call. Use to classify a wallet that buys pump.fun tokens (insider, latency_bot or skilled) and read its PnL when it ranks on our leaderboard. Not a mint's risk. Input: address (base58 wallet). Stale feed: refused before payment. Fields: loopholetape://schema/wallet_profile.

tools.name: rhc_regime
tools.description: Free. Robinhood Chain pons regime: launches and graduations per hour, graduation rate, median seconds to graduate, buys per minute, unique buyers, snipe-tax facts. Use it to gauge launch activity as a whole; for one curve use rhc_curve_card. No arguments.

tools.name: rhc_recent_launches
tools.description: $0.01 per call. New token launches on Robinhood Chain. Use to screen or poll new pons memecoins (default last hour) as structure cards: raised, taxes, concentration, ring block, each with verdict and basis. Filters: ring_only, since. Not Solana. Fields: loopholetape://schema/rhc_recent_launches.

tools.name: buy_api_key
tools.description: $2.00 once. Use when your client cannot sign x402 on every call: a prepaid key lt_... holding $2.00 of credit, sent as the X-API-Key header on POST /mcp or any paid HTTP route; each call's price is deducted. A bearer secret; credit does not expire. Try first: buy_trial_key. No arguments.

tools.name: buy_dataset
tools.description: $5.00 per day file. Use to backtest or train a rug or graduation model on one UTC day of pump.fun launches (about 15k-35k rows), not for live decisions. Input: day (YYYY-MM-DD; days on sale at free GET /v1/datasets). Returns a one-hour download URL.

tools.name: launches_since
tools.description: $0.001 per poll. New Solana tokens: every covered pump.fun memecoin launch after `since`, each with verdict and P(rug within 300 s). Use when polling: pass next_cursor back as since; an empty page costs the same. Stale feed: refused before payment. Fields: loopholetape://schema/launches_since.

tools.name: buy_trial_key
tools.description: $0.10 once. Use to try the paid tools: a prepaid key lt_... holding $0.10 of credit, sent as the X-API-Key header on POST /mcp or any paid HTTP route. A bearer secret. Larger credit: buy_api_key. No arguments.

tools.name: rhc_curve_card
tools.description: $0.02 per call. Use when you hold or are about to trade ONE pons v2 token on Robinhood Chain: verdict, basis, reasons, deployer record, exact sell_check, taxes, holders, ring screen. Input: address (0x). Unknown address: refused before payment. Fields: loopholetape://schema/rhc_curve_card.

tools.name: rhc_curve_trades
tools.description: $0.02 per page. Use to index or price a pons curve: Robinhood Chain reserves rebuilt to the wei, per buy, sell and buyback in block order: amounts, fee, taxes, price, next_cursor. Input: address, since, limit. ETH-paired curves up to 90 min old. Fields: loopholetape://schema/rhc_curve_trades.

tools.name: launches_screened
tools.description: $0.01 per call. New Solana tokens screened. Use to get new pump.fun memecoin launches (last 15 min) that the fixed rule does not mark avoid, ranked by P(true graduation). Stale feed or empty screen: refused before payment. Not a safety guarantee. Fields: loopholetape://schema/launches_screened.

tools.name: check_batch_risk
tools.description: $0.04 per call for one to 25 mints, not per mint. Use when a screener checks a list, some possibly outside the live window: the compact check item per covered mint, others listed as unavailable. Charged if any is covered. Not a safety guarantee. Fields: loopholetape://schema/check_batch_risk.

tools.name: mint_holders
tools.description: $0.01 per call. Solana token holder concentration for ONE pump.fun token. Use when you need who holds it now: top-5 and top-10 share, HHI, cohorts (dev, bundlers, snipers) with holder reputation. Labels are observations, not a verdict on a wallet. Fields: loopholetape://schema/mint_holders.

tools.name: mint_flow
tools.description: $0.01 per page. Use when you need who bought and sold ONE pump.fun token trade by trade, or to poll its new trades: curve buys and sells in slot order, summaries, demand, cohorts with holder reputation. Input: mint or link, since, limit. Fields: loopholetape://schema/mint_flow.

tools.name: mint_outcome
tools.description: $0.001 per call. Use to grade your own rug or graduation calls or backtest a signal: the outcome of ONE pump.fun launch by a fixed public rule (rugged and when, graduated and when), null until settled. An unknown mint answers known:false and is charged. Fields: loopholetape://schema/mint_outcome.

tools.name: mint_outcome_batch
tools.description: $0.01 per call whatever the answers. Use to grade a list of your own calls: the outcomes of 1 to 40 pump.fun mints, as mint_outcome ($0.001 alone). Input: mints. Fields: loopholetape://schema/mint_outcome_batch.

tools.name: rhc_swap_build_checked
tools.description: Free. Use it to swap a graduated pons token on Robinhood Chain: returns the UNSIGNED KyberSwap transaction to sign. Fee 0.25% (25 bps) to 0x25d408eF54e60F3006bD13d5A040d525E2F359c2 via router 0x6131B5fae19EA4f9D964eAc0408E4408b66337b5. Refused if our verdict is avoid or the quote is over 30 seconds

tools.name: swap_build_checked
tools.description: Free. Use it when you buy or sell a pump.fun token (curve or PumpSwap pool): without wallet an estimated quote (output, impact, fee) from curve or pool reserves; with wallet the UNSIGNED Jupiter swap. Refused on avoid/block. Fee: a disclosed 0.25% (25 bps) to loophole tape's wallet. Holds no keys.

tools.name: subscribe_alerts
tools.description: $0.10 once, for 30 days. Use when a Discord or Telegram room you own should get pump.fun and Robinhood Chain alerts without a server. Input: destination (Discord webhook URL or telegram:<bot_token>:<chat_id>), kinds. A test message goes first; a failed test is unpaid. At most 20 messages an hour.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_coverage, recent_rugs, recent_graduations, wallet_profile, buy_dataset, launches_screened, subscribe_alerts · Private data: token_check, new_launches_free, check_pumpfun_risk, verdict, mint_risk_card, pumpfun_recent_launches, recent_rugs, creator_reputation, wallet_profile, rhc_recent_launches, buy_api_key, buy_dataset, launches_since, buy_trial_key, rhc_curve_card, launches_screened, mint_holders, mint_flow, rhc_swap_build_checked, swap_build_checked · Public sink: market_regime, buy_api_key, buy_trial_key, mint_holders, subscribe_alerts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_coverage, recent_rugs, recent_graduations, wallet_profile, buy_dataset, launches_screened, subscribe_alerts · Private data: token_check, new_launches_free, check_pumpfun_risk, verdict, mint_risk_card, pumpfun_recent_launches, recent_rugs, creator_reputation, wallet_profile, rhc_recent_launches, buy_api_key, buy_dataset, launches_since, buy_trial_key, rhc_curve_card, launches_screened, mint_holders, mint_flow, rhc_swap_build_checked, swap_build_checked · Public sink: market_regime, buy_api_key, buy_trial_key, mint_holders, subscribe_alerts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
